identity.name: The Business Standard
identity.description: A Bangladeshi English-language business-focused newspaper and digital outlet covering the economy, markets, companies, policy and current affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Founded by Horizon Media and Publication Ltd in Dhaka. It combines original business reporting with selective syndicated analysis from international partners.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Commercial business publisher with no evidence of direct state or party ownership; syndicates international analysis alongside local reporting.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No MBFC rating; business-press framing is broadly centrist and policy-focused.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Editorial focus is markets, investment and business policy, with a generally market-friendly analytical orientation.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: National business lens with emphasis on Bangladesh's investment climate and regional trade.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Professional business newsroom with named reporting, but limited independent verification and no external rating; syndicated content varies in quality.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for The Business Standard.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Business-first national coverage. Explains Bangladesh through markets, investment, banking and policy, with less emphasis on grassroots reporting.

selectionRationale: Adds dedicated Bangladeshi business and economic coverage that complements general national outlets.

feeds.validationNote: 10 items; valid XML but stale since November 2021; do not activate.
